police_spending: Police departments should be replaced with other public-safety services.
Police spending should be cut a lot, with the money moved to social services.
Police spending should be cut somewhat, with some money moved to social services.
Police spending should stay about the same.
Police spending should go up somewhat, to hire and train more officers.
Police spending should go up a lot, to hire and train many more officers.
crisis_responders: Trained mental health workers, without police, should answer 911 calls about a mental health crisis with no weapon or violence.
Mental health workers and police should answer those calls together.
Police officers with mental health training should answer those calls.
qualified_immunity: People should be able to sue officers who violate their constitutional rights; qualified immunity should end.
Officers should be suable for serious violations even without an identical earlier case.
Qualified immunity should stay as it is, blocking most such lawsuits.
Officers should get even more legal protection from lawsuits than today.
misconduct_records: All complaints about police misconduct should be public, including ones not proven.
Only misconduct complaints found to be true should be public.
Police misconduct complaints should stay confidential.
mandatory_minimums: Mandatory minimum sentences should end, and judges should decide each sentence.
Mandatory minimums should stay only for violent crimes.
Mandatory minimums should stay as they are, including for crimes like drug dealing.
There should be more mandatory minimums, and longer ones.
violent_sentences: Sentences for violent crimes like armed robbery are much too long.
Sentences for violent crimes are somewhat too long.
Sentences for violent crimes are about right.
Sentences for violent crimes are somewhat too short.
Sentences for violent crimes are much too short.
death_penalty: The death penalty should never be used, even for murder.
The death penalty should be used only for the most extreme murders, like killing several people or a child.
The death penalty should be used for most planned murders.
death_penalty_cases: The death penalty shouldn't be possible for this: {case}.
The death penalty should be possible for this: {case}.
cash_bail: Cash bail should end, and almost everyone should be released before trial unless they're clearly dangerous.
Most people charged with nonviolent crimes should be released without bail; judges set bail for others.
Cash bail should stay, with judges setting the amounts.
Everyone charged with a violent or repeat crime should stay in jail until trial.

s: Prisons should focus on education and treatment to prepare people for release, even if it costs more.
I lean toward prisons focusing on rehabilitation.
I lean toward prisons focusing on punishment and protecting the public.
Prisons should focus on punishing crime and protecting the public, even if fewer people change their ways.
prison_purpose.torn: I weigh rehabilitation and punishment about equally.

s: Employers and landlords should be limited in using nonviolent criminal records, even if they take on some risk.
I lean toward limiting how criminal records can be used, to give second chances.
I lean toward letting employers and landlords consider criminal records.
Employers and landlords should be free to consider criminal records, even if that makes it harder for people to rebuild their lives.
second_chance.torn: I weigh second chances and freedom to consider records about equally.

juveniles_adult_court: Teenagers aged 15 to 17 should always be tried in juvenile court, even for serious violent crimes.
Teenagers aged 15 to 17 should be tried as adults only for murder.
Teenagers accused of serious violent crimes can be tried as adults if a judge decides.
Teenagers accused of serious violent crimes should automatically be tried as adults.
private_prisons: Private companies shouldn't be allowed to run prisons or immigration detention centers.
Private prisons and detention centers are acceptable only under strict oversight.
Governments should use private prisons and detention centers if they save money.
road_blocking: Peaceful protesters should be allowed to block a road briefly.
Police should ask protesters blocking a road to move, and arrest only those who refuse.
Protesters blocking a road should be arrested right away.
Protesters blocking a road should be arrested and face serious charges, with possible jail time.
riot_response: When a protest turns into rioting, authorities should use as little force as possible and focus on calming things down.
Authorities should arrest people damaging property, but avoid force against peaceful protesters.
Authorities should use whatever force it takes to stop a riot quickly, including the National Guard.
troops_in_cities: A president should never send troops into a city over the governor's objection.
A president can send troops over a governor's objection only during a riot or uprising local police can't control.
A president can send troops into a city whenever the president judges crime is out of control, even if the governor objects.
victims_voice: Victims' views shouldn't affect sentencing or parole; decisions should rest on the law and the offender.
Victims can speak at sentencing and parole hearings, but their wishes shouldn't get special weight.
Victims' views should carry significant weight in sentencing and parole.
asset_forfeiture: Police should be able to take cash or property only after the owner is convicted of a crime.
Police can take property without a conviction only with strong evidence, and the government must prove its case.
Police should be able to take property they suspect is linked to a crime without a conviction, as most states allow.
stop_and_frisk: Police shouldn't stop and pat down people just because they find them suspicious.
Police can stop and frisk only for specific reasons, which are recorded and reviewed for bias.
Police should be able to stop and frisk people they find suspicious in high-crime areas.
